title: N-Sample Enable
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Signal Management/Switches and Counters/N_Sample_Enable.md
text: Output ones or zeros for specified number of sample times, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Trigger type} sets Type of triggering event Rising; {Trigger count, N} sets the number of samples to output the active, {Active level}, {Reset input} enables reset input port, {Sample time} sets the output sample period and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Trigger count, N
params.values: Number of samples to output the active value 8 (default) | scalar integer

params.name: Reset input
params.values: Enable reset input port off (default) | on

params.name: Trigger type
params.values: Type of triggering event Rising edge (default) | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample
